description:
Get a concise AI-generated digest summarizing a fragrance's community reviews — key themes, consensus, and standout opinions. Public, cached per fragrance.

See also: `fragrance_get_reviews` for individual reviews · `fragrance_get` for full profile.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

id.description: Fragrance UUID or CUID to get the review digest for

name: fragrance_review_digest
